about: Roger A. Dreyer attended law school and graduated from University of California College of the Law, San Francisco (formerly UC Hastings) in 1980. Roger Dreyer began practicing law in 1980.

Roger Dreyer is an attorney at Dreyer Babich Buccola Wood Campora, LLP, helping people with Personal Injury - General: Plaintiff issues. Dreyer Babich Buccola Wood Campora, LLP has an office in Sacramento, California, serving the local community.

Roger Dreyer was selected to Super Lawyers for 2004 - 2026. Super Lawyers is an exclusive list of top-rated attorneys in specific practice areas who were chosen after thorough evaluation of numerous criteria.
